title: Happy Christmas! Everyone!
content:
I don't use AI very well, but this time, I made an AI model to wear my clothes and used it for the first time for a Christmas look.

For this visual, I used CLO-modeled clothes, but we used AI-made models, AI-made backgrounds. 

The AI used nanobanana.![ec7f76bb0ad14fea9563083ac1e6e92b](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202512/70dcb4d9d35b4f2aa6f8f1f54baa3044/images/ec7f76bb0ad14fea9563083ac1e6e92bGenerated%20Image%20December%2024%2C%202025%20-%205_36AM.jpeg)

I chose it because the time given was not long, but I think it was a good way to complete it in time for Christmas Eve.

![c057723a6a8c4904a535e2f6a33ddfda](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202512/70dcb4d9d35b4f2aa6f8f1f54baa3044/images/c057723a6a8c4904a535e2f6a33ddfdaGenerated%20Image%20December%2023%2C%202025%20-%208_11AM.jpg)

I think it's a way of working that I'll often use when I don't have long time to invest in render in the future.

![4d25f66a8cc64cceae3026092fa58070](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202512/70dcb4d9d35b4f2aa6f8f1f54baa3044/images/4d25f66a8cc64cceae3026092fa58070Generated%20Image%20December%2023%2C%202025%20-%2011_48PM.jpeg)

I've heard Nanobanana's reputation well, but I think it's so good as a way to use it instead of a render.

  
Above all, I think it's very satisfactory that you don't change the details of the clothes arbitrarily.

I was very surprised to see that the characteristics of the velvet fabric, Fur fabric used in CLO reflect very well.

Rendered it in A pose so that the clothes wouldn't be covered up, and just ordered it to "wear it" as a prompt, they understood so well.

![fda7e4f446df4485b67d31c76f56da8b](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202512/70dcb4d9d35b4f2aa6f8f1f54baa3044/images/fda7e4f446df4485b67d31c76f56da8bChristmas%20Look.png)

There are many people who already use it, but I recommend you to use it when you have a lot of worries about directing factors such as poses and backgrounds.  
  
Then have a happy Christmas!

![b8c2482eac414b8b8f989adad4b2b306](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202512/70dcb4d9d35b4f2aa6f8f1f54baa3044/images/b8c2482eac414b8b8f989adad4b2b306Generated%20Image%20December%2023%2C%202025%20-%208_07AM.jpeg)
content_description: Explore my innovative use of AI to showcase CLO-modeled clothing in a festive Christmas look, highlighting the benefits of quick rendering and realistic fabric representation.

title: My Geometry Cache isn't visible in my render on UE5.6, how to fix it ?
content:
Hello guys, i'm currently working on a project with clothes I've import thru the pipeline between UE5 and CLO, but it's onle giving me the geometry cache and when I'm animating it in my sequencer, nothing appear on screen, what's the problem ? My import settings ?   
  
Thanks for your help team !  
  
![5d864eacbbc0408d8f954b3b0d3c25b0](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202512/7c7d1a375cef47d782c0fe5f5e56064b/images/5d864eacbbc0408d8f954b3b0d3c25b0Capture%20d%27%C3%A9cran%202025-12-23%20093323.png)![70eaa56f303841a8996576f689ca578c](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202512/7c7d1a375cef47d782c0fe5f5e56064b/images/70eaa56f303841a8996576f689ca578c.0242.jpeg)Here you can see the viewport VS the render (no clothes on the character)

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Hi machiavhell.3d,It is difficult to determine the exact cause of the issue based on the information provided. When you import the animated garment from CLO and save it as a Geometry Cache asset, is the resulting asset valid? Additionally, when you inspect the asset in the Content Browser, does it show the animation from CLO?Best regards,Bryan

Comment 2: Hi There. Thank you for the post. It looks like you do not have an active CLO account attached to the account. Can you please let us know what you CLO account name is? Thank you 🙂We do always recommend posting questions using the account that is attached to your active CLO subscription
Reply 1: How can I do that ? And how is this supposed to help me ?
Reply 2: Hi. All CLO accounts have a user ID or name. that can be found on your clo3d.com account page. This is to ensure that you have a valid CLO license and helps us to know what version you are using. This helps our team to best help you. Since this account is not linked to a CLO license we do not know what type of license you are using (student, individual, crack, enterprise, academic) or what version you are using. We recommend logging into your clo3d account and in your profile page you should find this in the upper left. thank you
content_description: This webpage aims to seek assistance and troubleshoot issues related to importing animated clothing from CLO to UE5, specifically focusing on the visibility of garments during animation sequences.

title: Flatten pieces smaller than the avatar measure
content:
After flattening the pieces smaller than avatar measure

how to make it correctly?  
I tried to reduce the fabric thickness, but it's not influence to the 2D pattern measurements. I tried to reduce the collision, same result.  
Please see the picture attached.  
I have the latest version.

![86f83a5051bc4c9fb42e71b53062ff1d](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202512/7e60595fc23c4e389ff5ec3066ca2a4a/images/86f83a5051bc4c9fb42e71b53062ff1dFlattening%20clo_Help.png)

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Hi. These pieces will often still require editing after they are fattened. Since they are trying to flatten on a human shape what has lots of curve you will often not get the same measurements as the avatar. But I have often gotten closer measurements by adding additional seams on the avatar before flattening
Reply 1: Hi Arielthank you for your replay.I understood the issue in general, but the deviation is too big, like 2 cm for the fool circumference. can you please give me some example of your adding additional seams for the avatar.
Reply 2: You likely need a side seam
Reply 3: i tried also with seams and its still with difference. Anyway thank you for the answer
content_description: This web page aims to provide guidance on correctly flattening fabric pieces in 2D patterns while addressing common issues related to size reduction and collision adjustments.

title: Error - Failed To Live Update
content:
While I try to update the app I get this error and the update starts over.

I tried It several times.

How can I fix It?

### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Update here as well. I tried to clean install now It worked.

Comment 2: Thank you @CLO Designer - YouTube LiveSharing my update on the issue- I have uninstall the clo by following all the description mentioned in the https://connect.clo-set.com/community/post/2c231cc2d1834227a8919b0d2a61a68f and then installed the latest version, and it worked.

Comment 3: I finally decided to try to use a 5g hotspot to download and it went. It's incredibly frustrating if the speed of the internet is stopping live updates.

Comment 4: I have the same problem. It doesn't matter which computer I use, the last few updates failed halway through. I shouldn't have to reinstall every time there is an update. Please advise the update team that this is a HUGE problem.

Comment 5: I removed the app and reinstalled. The problem remains.???

Comment 6: If you have failed to live update multiple times the fastest solution is often to uninstall CLO. Then download CLO again from our website1) Save your work files, including CLO project files, in a safe place, Do not save your own project files neither in the public asset folder nor the installation folder. (It is necessary in order to prevent the loss of your project files during the re-installation steps.) 2) Please refer to the web document below to completely delete CLO and the files that make up CLO from your computer. https://connect.clo-set.com/community/post/2c231cc2d1834227a8919b0d2a61a68f 3) Download the latest installer from the CLO website and install it with administrator privileges. You can download the latest Installer here: https://connect.clo-set.com/community/post/2c231cc2d1834227a8919b0d2a61a68f
Reply 1: is there another way ? I do not want to uninstall
Reply 2: I uninstalled the app and reinstalled. The problem still continues. ??

Comment 7: I am also facing the same issue, and it's happening for CLO 2025.2.236 version update
Reply 1: me the same issue
Reply 2: You will likely need to uninstall and reinstall. If the issue persists then please reach out to our Tech Support directly https://connect.clo-set.com/community/post/2c231cc2d1834227a8919b0d2a61a68f
content_description: This webpage aims to provide troubleshooting solutions for users encountering repeated errors while attempting to update their app.

title: Fit:match Virtual Roundtable | Real-Body Data in CLO 3D Design
content:
![af7220e58d9347a2848b9999c610bece](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202512/0f525d8523124f2e928883fd2de44348/images/af7220e58d9347a2848b9999c610beceCopy%20of%20RoundTable%20%282%29.png)Fit:match recently hosted a virtual roundtable with **Linda Burhance, Hilary Nagler, and Dorelle McPherson** discussing how real-body data from **QuadraScan** is transforming 3D design workflows. The conversation explored how mobile scanning can expand avatar libraries, support more inclusive size strategies, and help designers create products that better reflect real customers.

Watch the full recording here:  
<https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Xk_eHECuF_M>

QuadraScan is now available for brands, 3D teams, and design schools looking to move beyond static avatars and incorporate scalable, accurate body data into their workflows.
content_description: Discover how QuadraScan's real-body data is revolutionizing 3D design workflows for brands and design schools, enhancing inclusivity and accuracy in product development.
Discover sustainable fashion choices that empower your style while protecting the planet.
